registration_basis: Assigned from source functions and input-family structure before inspecting any expanded model outputs. No model results were read to assign these tags.

complexity_definitions.low: A local shape, type, membership, literal-match, or early-guard decision.
complexity_definitions.medium: A normalization, boundary, uniqueness, lookup, or transformation rule without a substantial combination of defaults or precedence.
complexity_definitions.high: Multiple interacting fields, precedence/default merging, structured sequence/order decisions, or specialized runtime lookup semantics.

limitations: Complexity is an authored structural estimate, not an executable ground-truth label or a measured property of a model.
Related cases share templates; sample counts are not independent observation counts.
Task type, source module length, and complexity are correlated. Use within-function/task comparisons before attributing differences to complexity.
Source rules are supplied intentionally; the analysis does not establish broad real-world task difficulty.
